approach_why: A recruiter screens this posting against its list of requirements, so the map answers each line.

paragraphs.text: Your posting lists what this role has to do. Here is what I bring to each part.

map.ask: Scale an engineering organization through rapid growth
map.answer: I grew Acme engineering from 12 to 45 engineers across six teams.
I cut release lead time at Acme from 10 days to under one day with trunk-based delivery and CI/CD.
I led the SOC 2 Type II program at Acme to a clean first audit.
I built a structured interview loop at Globex that hired 35 engineers in 18 months, and I mentored eight engineers into management or staff roles.

paragraphs.text: Where I would ramp up: payments. My platform work so far has been in B2B software, not card processing.
Happy to go through any row on a call.
